name: Harukaze Nana
source:
Nana loves sweets, especially the ones [url=/c98201]Natsumi[/url] makes. Although [url=/c98612]Mashiro[/url] often toys with her, Nana always overcomes everything with her energetic personality. She also strives to support [url=/c98249]Kotori[/url] as a reliable senpai.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
